content.name: Brandon Hayes
content.title: Store Manager
content.summary: Store manager with nearly ten years in specialty retail across home goods, outdoor gear and pet supplies in the Phoenix area. Runs a $6.8M flagship pet store with 34 employees, where a grooming salon expansion and labor scheduling overhaul raised four-wall profit by $410,000 in two years.

experience.title: Store Manager (Flagship)
bullets: Run the chain's highest-volume store at $6.8M in annual sales, leading 34 employees including two assistant managers and a grooming lead.
Doubled grooming salon capacity from six to twelve tables and filled the new slots within five months, adding $520,000 in annual service revenue.
Rebuilt the weekly schedule around hourly traffic counts, cutting labor from 14.2% to 12.6% of sales without longer checkout waits.
Brought inventory shrink down from 2.1% to 1.3% through cycle counts, receiving audits and camera placement reviews with loss prevention.
Coached one assistant manager into her own store and kept annual hourly turnover at 38%, well below the district average.

experience.title: Store Manager
bullets: Managed a $3.9M store with 22 staff selling camping, climbing and hiking equipment.
Grew sales 17% in 2021 by adding a gear rental counter and weekend trailhead clinics.
Kept the store profitable through 2020 by launching curbside pickup within a week and reassigning staff to online order fulfillment.
Passed every quarterly operations audit with scores above 95%.

experience.title: Assistant Store Manager
bullets: Supervised 15 associates across opening and closing shifts and managed truck processing of up to 1,200 cartons a week.
Ran seasonal resets for holiday and back-to-college, finishing floor sets a day ahead of the corporate deadline.
Handled hiring interviews and new-hire training, reducing 90-day turnover from 45% to 29%.

education.school: W. P. Carey School of Business, Arizona State University

achievements.title: Store of the Year
achievements.detail: Sonoran Pet Market flagship named company store of the year in 2024.

achievements.title: Leadership pipeline
achievements.detail: Two team members promoted to assistant manager and one to store manager.
